degree_rationale: The Calling and the Answer as letters of peace and salutation — first sent from Living Spirit to mold of man, then sent up from Man to Living Spirit. Mind of Light came from Christ. Treats the natural epistolary/messenger structure of cosmic salvation.
direction_rationale: Originating natural communication — how the divine letter-system reaches into the human, generative of relationship.
grand_man_function: Natural messenger-system — the letters of cosmic salvation.
title: The Apostle's peace and salutation: five mysteries from the Father
